title: Breath of the Wild BetterVR
licence: MIT for BetterVR; linked game, emulator, graphic packs and other dependencies retain their own terms
evidence_role: Direct public implementation evidence for emulator-layer flat-to-VR conversion using a Vulkan interception layer, OpenXR presentation, translated game-code patches, stereo frame scheduling, room-scale embodiment and physical interaction.
game_boundary: Requires a legal Wii U copy of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. BetterVR states that it ships no game files and modifies code rather than game data.

current_runtime_notes.emulator: Cemu 2.6 or newer; 2.6 is the tested version in the current README

distinct_value: emulator-layer VR conversion rather than direct native-game injection
PowerPC game-code patches coordinated with emulator/Vulkan presentation
Vulkan to D3D12 interoperability for OpenXR submission
full hands and arms with physical weapons, gestures, melee and bow drawing
first-person and optional third-person VR presentation
room-scale and camera-comfort handling across movement, mounting and climbing
large mod compatibility because the VR layer avoids modifying game data
in-game settings and diagnostics plus fail-visible setup requirements
known_boundaries: Version 1.0 is being actively worked toward but is not released at the admitted snapshot.
The current public release is 0.9.20, not 1.0.
Performance is constrained by CPU-heavy Wii U emulation as well as VR rendering.
The README currently recommends alternatives to Meta/Oculus Link for Quest due to interpolation artefacts; this is upstream operational guidance, not local Quest 3 proof.
Do not infer that Cemu, Nintendo game code, game assets, community graphic packs or third-party dependencies are MIT because BetterVR itself is MIT.
Do not reproduce Nintendo game data or require an unauthorised game image for research.
Any local Battle Bridge or Quest 3 experiment remains separately approval- and proof-gated.
promotion_rule: Promote only exact-release, evidence-linked methods from the MIT BetterVR source while keeping emulator, game, graphic-pack and dependency rights separate. Treat the emulator-layer conversion architecture as reusable research knowledge, not as proof that Starfield or other native PC games expose the same hooks.
